subject: Planned maintenance: eastus2 kernel/driver patching (staggered restarts) - Oct 11-12
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Ops Team <infra-ops@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T08:00:00Z
Subject: Planned maintenance: eastus2 kernel/driver patching (staggered restarts) - Oct 11-12

Hi Jamie / Acme Ops team,

Quick heads-up: Redwood will perform a staged kernel and NIC driver patch in eastus2 starting Monday Oct 11 at 09:00 PT (16:00 UTC) and continuing into Tue Oct 12. This is a rolling, low-impact maintenance window designed to avoid simultaneous host reboots for tenant isolation and predictable SLOs.

Summary of what to expect:
- Window: Oct 11 09:00 PT -> Oct 12 11:00 PT (staggered waves, each wave ~20–30 min host reboot)
- Impact: brief connection disruption to in-flight inference sessions on hosts being patched; API endpoints will failover to healthy hosts automatically. We expect <1% transient error rate for affected tokens during a wave.
- Mitigations: prefix caching maintained, aggressive routing to healthy zones, automatic retry guidance for SDKs documented in the attached runbook.

Attachments: redwood-eastus2-maintenance-plan-v2.pdf (detailed schedule), patch_runbook-staggered-sequence.txt (operator steps).

Request: please confirm Acme's acceptable blackout windows and whether you want us to avoid patching your reserved Dedicated pool between 10:30–12:30 PT. If we don't hear back, we'll proceed with the schedule above.

Cheers,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Reliability
Redwood Inference

From: Jamie Torres <jamie.torres@acmecloud.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Ops Team <infra-ops@acmecloud.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T09:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Planned maintenance: eastus2 kernel/driver patching (staggered restarts) - Oct 11-12

Thanks Rishi — appreciate the notice.

A few quick questions from our side:
1) Can you confirm whether Dedicated instances for our "acme-prod" reservation will be included by default or need an explicit opt-in?
2) If a host in a Dedicated pool is rebooted, what is the observed reconnect behavior for long-lived streaming responses? Any recommended client retry backoff?
3) Can you provide an ETA for when any failing tokens will be retried by Redwood, versus when the client should retry?

We prefer avoiding restarts for acme-prod between 10:00–12:00 PT due to scheduled reporting. If you can skip that slot, that would be great.

Jamie
Senior Cloud Ops
Acme Cloud

Rishi / team — quick coordination notes for the runbook and customer request: 
- Opt-in for Dedicated pools: we should treat acme-prod as "opt-out" for this wave unless they sign the DocuSign (DOCU-SIGN-REQ-8742). Jamie's ask to avoid 10:00–12:00 PT is noted; we'll skip that slot for their reserved hosts.
- Streaming reconnects: observed pattern is client should retry with exponential backoff starting at 250ms; Redwood also attempts immediate in-service routing where possible. Include client retry guidance in the one-pager.
- Retry ownership: Redwood routing will attempt transparent replay for short-lived prefix/KV cache reconnections for up to 30s; after that clients should retry. Add explicit wording to the attachment.

Operational run: Laura, Tessa — please coordinate wave IDs 3 and 4 (hosts 1200–1224). Marissa — please prepare the post-maintenance incident note template and update the status page snippets.

I'll update the maintenance-plan-v2 with acme-prod exclusion and re-upload.

—Monica
Sr. SRE, Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-10-12T11:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Planned maintenance: eastus2 kernel/driver patching (staggered restarts) - Oct 11-12

Jamie — thanks for the coordination. Maintenance completed for eastus2 at 11:15 PT on Oct 12. Topline summary below and a link to the full post-maintenance report attached to the shared drive.

Topline: 
- All scheduled waves completed on time; no host reboots exceeded the expected downtime window (median host out-of-service 18 minutes).
- Observed transient 0.7% increase in 5xxs across eastus2 during waves; automatic routing and SDK retries reduced user-visible errors to ~0.05% on average.
- Dedicated pool "acme-prod": honored exclusion for 10:00–12:00 PT; we patched outside that slot and validated reboots. No impact observed on scheduled reporting.
- Attachments/links: full runbook and CSV of host wave timings uploaded: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/infra/shared/eastus2-maintenance-plan-v2

Action items: 
- Marissa will publish the post-maintenance note (status.redwood.com entry) and send the summary to your distribution list (Jamie).
- Monica to file a short RCA if any of the host wave timings require follow-up (none flagged beyond expected variance).

If you want a quick debrief call this week, happy to set 20 minutes.

Thanks again for the quick replies and for opting out of the critical slot — that made scheduling simpler.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Reliability
Redwood Inference
